# 1. Load Data
```{r}
# loading results from cluster back in here - Define the file path
file_path <- "../data/HPC_outputs/40cells_msh2_sliding_window_GLM_1000bootstrap_results.csv"

# Read the CSV into a data frame
modeling_results <- read.csv(file_path)

# Calculate Benjamini-Hochberg Adjusted P-value on raw, full data (only for successful models)
modeling_results <- modeling_results %>%
  mutate(
    adjusted_p_value = if_else(
      status == "OK" & !is.na(median_p_value),
      p.adjust(median_p_value, method = "BH"),
      as.numeric(NA)
    )
  )

# Now, add the 'window' column to your dataframe
modeling_results <- modeling_results %>%
  mutate(
    window = if_else(
      # This is the condition to check
      window_scheme == "NA_control_window",

      # Value if the condition is TRUE
      ATAC_bin,

      # Value if the condition is FALSE
      # This part extracts the chromosome and pastes it with the window start/end
      paste0(sub(":.*", "", ATAC_bin), ":", window_start, "-", window_end)
    )
  )

# Relocate the 'window' column
modeling_results <- modeling_results %>%
  relocate(window, .after = window_end)


# Create a data frame for control bins, sorted alphabetically
control_bins <- modeling_results %>%
  filter(is.na(window_start)) %>%
  arrange(window)

# Create a data frame for experimental bins, sorted by genomic position
experimental_bins <- modeling_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(window_start)) %>%
  arrange(window_start)

# Combine the two sets to create the final, ordered list for the x-axis
final_bin_order <- c(unique(control_bins$window), unique(experimental_bins$window))

# Convert the 'window' column into an ordered factor
modeling_results$window <- factor(modeling_results$window, levels = final_bin_order)

# Convert the 'dose' column to a factor with numerically sorted levels
# This will place the highest dose (100) at the top and the lowest (0) at the bottom.
modeling_results$dose <- factor(
  modeling_results$dose,
  levels = sort(unique(modeling_results$dose), decreasing = TRUE)
)

modeling_results_raw <- modeling_results
```


```{r}
# Calculate the value that 95% of the data is below (i.e., the top 5%)
top_5_percent_threshold <- quantile(
  abs(modeling_results$mean_normalized_effect),
  probs = 0.95,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

# Print the result
print(top_5_percent_threshold)
```


```{r}
# Make sure ggplot2 is loaded
library(ggplot2)

# Create the count-based histogram plot (no density line)
p <- ggplot(modeling_results, aes(x = mean_normalized_effect)) +
  # Add a histogram with counts on the y-axis (default)
  geom_histogram(bins = 100, fill = "dimgrey", alpha = 0.7) +

  # Add a vertical line for the lower threshold (-top 5%)
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = -top_5_percent_threshold,
    color = "blue",
    linetype = "dashed",
    size = 1
  ) +

  # Add a vertical line for the upper threshold (+top 5%)
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = top_5_percent_threshold,
    color = "red",
    linetype = "dashed",
    size = 1
  ) +

  # Add labels and a title
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Mean Normalized Effect - 40 cell threshold",
    x = "Mean Normalized Effect",
    y = "Count",
    caption = paste0("Dashed lines indicate (+/- ", round(top_5_percent_threshold, 3), ")")
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 6)
  )

# Print the plot
p

# Save the plot as a PDF with specific dimensions and font sizes
pdf_dir <- output_dir
dir.create(pdf_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(pdf_dir, "40cells_dist_mean_norm_effect.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 3.1,
  height = 3.0,
  units = "in"
)

# Clean up variables to prevent any side effects on downstream chunks
rm(p, pdf_dir)
```




# --- 3. Interactive Lollipop Plots ---
```{r}
# --- 1. Load Libraries ---
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(htmlwidgets)

# --- 2. Enhanced function to generate distinct colors ---
generate_distinct_colors <- function(n) {
  golden_ratio_conjugate <- 0.61803398875
  h <- runif(1)
  hues <- (h + (1:n) * golden_ratio_conjugate) %% 1
  sv_pairs <- list(
    c(s = 0.9, v = 0.85), c(s = 0.4, v = 0.95), c(s = 0.9, v = 0.6),
    c(s = 0.25, v = 0.98), c(s = 0.7, v = 0.7)
  )
  s_values <- rep(sapply(sv_pairs, `[`, 1), length.out = n)
  v_values <- rep(sapply(sv_pairs, `[`, 2), length.out = n)
  hsv(h = hues, s = s_values, v = v_values)
}

# --- 3. Create a High-Contrast Master Color Key ---
ordered_bins <- modeling_results %>%
  arrange(window) %>%
  pull(ATAC_bin) %>%
  unique()
num_bins <- length(ordered_bins)
distinct_colors <- generate_distinct_colors(n = num_bins)
atac_color_map <- data.frame(
  ATAC_bin = ordered_bins,
  bin_color = distinct_colors
)

# --- 4. Join the Color Map to the Main Dataframe ---
if (!"bin_color" %in% names(modeling_results)) {
  modeling_results <- modeling_results %>%
    left_join(atac_color_map, by = "ATAC_bin")
}

# --- 5. Define the Custom Color Scale for Lollipops ---
min_effect <- min(modeling_results$mean_normalized_effect, na.rm = TRUE)
max_effect <- max(modeling_results$mean_normalized_effect, na.rm = TRUE)
range_effect <- max_effect - min_effect

# Calculate symmetrical limits for color scale based on ACTUAL data range
actual_max_abs <- max(abs(range(modeling_results$mean_normalized_effect, na.rm = TRUE)))
# Ensure we cover at least the cap to avoid errors
actual_max_abs <- max(actual_max_abs, 1.5)

# Define the cap and threshold
cap_val <- 1.0
thresh_val <- top_5_percent_threshold

# Calculate normalized positions (0 to 1) for the gradient stops
# The scale spans from -actual_max_abs to +actual_max_abs
total_span <- 2 * actual_max_abs

# Function to normalize a value to [0, 1] given the range [-actual_max_abs, actual_max_abs]
norm_pos <- function(val) {
  (val - (-actual_max_abs)) / total_span
}

v_neg_cap <- norm_pos(-cap_val)
v_neg_thresh <- norm_pos(-thresh_val)
v_pos_thresh <- norm_pos(thresh_val)
v_pos_cap <- norm_pos(cap_val)

# Create the custom colorscale: blue -> blue -> lightgrey -> lightgrey -> red -> red
custom_colorscale <- list(
  list(0, "blue"),
  list(v_neg_cap, "blue"),
  list(v_neg_thresh, "lightgrey"),
  list(v_pos_thresh, "lightgrey"),
  list(v_pos_cap, "red"),
  list(1, "red")
)

# --- 6. Build the Header Plot ---
header_data <- modeling_results %>%
  dplyr::select(window, ATAC_bin, bin_color) %>%
  distinct()
p_header <- plot_ly(
  data = header_data,
  x = ~window, y = 1, type = "bar",
  marker = list(color = ~bin_color),
  hoverinfo = "text", text = ~ paste("ATAC Bin:", ATAC_bin)
) %>% layout(yaxis = list(showticklabels = FALSE, title = ""))

# --- 7. Build the Main Lollipop Plots ---
dose_plots <- list()
dose_levels <- levels(modeling_results$dose)
for (d in dose_levels) {
  dose_data <- filter(modeling_results, dose == d)
  dose_data_na <- filter(dose_data, is.na(mean_normalized_effect))
  dose_data_non_na <- filter(dose_data, !is.na(mean_normalized_effect))

  p_dose <- plot_ly(showlegend = FALSE) %>%
    add_segments(
      data = dose_data_non_na,
      x = ~window, y = 0, xend = ~window, yend = ~mean_normalized_effect,
      color = I("gray"), hoverinfo = "none"
    ) %>%
    add_markers(
      data = dose_data_non_na,
      x = ~window, y = ~mean_normalized_effect,
      marker = list(
        color = ~mean_normalized_effect, colorscale = custom_colorscale,
        cmin = -actual_max_abs, cmax = actual_max_abs,
        showscale = (d == "100"),
        colorbar = list(title = "Norm Effect"),
        size = 10
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text", text = ~ paste0(
        "Bin: ", ATAC_bin, "<br>",
        "Window: ", window, "<br>",
        "Scheme: ", window_scheme, "<br>",
        "Effect: ", round(mean_normalized_effect, 3), "<br>",
        "Adj. P-val: ", ifelse(is.na(adjusted_p_value), "NA", format.pval(adjusted_p_value, digits = 3)), "<br>",
        "CI: ", round(conf_low_95, 3), " - ", round(conf_high_95, 3), "<br>",
        "Cell Count: ", cell_count, "<br>",
        "Unique sgRNAs: ", num_unique_sgrnas, "<br>",
        "Status: ", status
      )
    ) %>%
    add_markers(
      data = dose_data_na, x = ~window, y = 0,
      marker = list(color = "black", size = 10),
      hoverinfo = "text", text = ~ paste0(
        "Bin: ", ATAC_bin, "<br>",
        "Window: ", window, "<br>",
        "Scheme: ", window_scheme, "<br>",
        "Effect: NA", "<br>",
        "Adj. P-val: ", ifelse(is.na(adjusted_p_value), "NA", format.pval(adjusted_p_value, digits = 3)), "<br>",
        "CI: ", round(conf_low_95, 3), " - ", round(conf_high_95, 3), "<br>",
        "Cell Count: ", cell_count, "<br>",
        "Unique sgRNAs: ", num_unique_sgrnas, "<br>",
        "Status: ", status
      )
    ) %>%
    add_annotations(
      text = paste(d), x = 1, y = 0.5,
      xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      xanchor = "left", showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(size = 14)
    )
  dose_plots[[as.character(d)]] <- p_dose
}

# --- 8. Combine All Plots and Enforce Order ---
final_plot <- subplot(
  p_header, dose_plots[["100"]], dose_plots[["50"]],
  dose_plots[["10"]], dose_plots[["0"]],
  nrows = 5, heights = c(0.1, 0.225, 0.225, 0.225, 0.225),
  shareX = TRUE, titleY = TRUE
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Genomic Window",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = final_bin_order,
      tickangle = 60
    ),
    title = list(text = "Dose-Dependent Effect Across Genomic Windows-1000 bootstrap 150bp window", y = 0.99)
  )

# --- 9. Save the Final Interactive Plot ---
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  widget = final_plot,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "cells40_all_modeling_results_interactive_lollipop_final.html")
)
```


```{r}
# --- 10. Save the Global Static Lollipop Plot (All Modeling Results) ---
# This replicates the style of the significant windows version but for the complete dataset.

# 1. Prepare Data using the full results set
modeling_results_static_all <- modeling_results %>%
  mutate(dose = factor(as.character(dose), levels = c("100", "50", "10", "0"))) %>%
  mutate(window = factor(as.character(window), levels = final_bin_order))

# 2. Calculate dynamic scale limits (based on ALL results)
all_cell_range <- range(modeling_results_static_all$cell_count, na.rm = TRUE)
min_all_cells <- all_cell_range[1]
max_all_cells <- all_cell_range[2]

# 3. Define the Color Scale (Using the same logic as the interactive plot)
if (!exists("actual_max_abs") || is.null(actual_max_abs)) {
  actual_max_abs <- max(abs(range(modeling_results_static_all$mean_normalized_effect, na.rm = TRUE)))
  actual_max_abs <- max(actual_max_abs, 1.5)
}
cap_val_all <- 1.0
thresh_val_all <- top_5_percent_threshold
total_span_all <- 2 * actual_max_abs

norm_pos_all <- function(val) {
  (val - (-actual_max_abs)) / total_span_all
}

v_neg_cap_all <- norm_pos_all(-cap_val_all)
v_neg_thresh_all <- norm_pos_all(-thresh_val_all)
v_pos_thresh_all <- norm_pos_all(thresh_val_all)
v_pos_cap_all <- norm_pos_all(cap_val_all)

# 4. Create the Static Lollipop Plot
p_lollipop_all_static <- ggplot(modeling_results_static_all, aes(x = window)) +
  geom_linerange(
    data = subset(modeling_results_static_all, !is.na(mean_normalized_effect)),
    aes(ymin = 0, ymax = mean_normalized_effect),
    color = "gray"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(modeling_results_static_all, !is.na(mean_normalized_effect)),
    aes(y = mean_normalized_effect, color = mean_normalized_effect),
    size = 2.0, alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = subset(modeling_results_static_all, is.na(mean_normalized_effect)),
    aes(y = 0),
    color = "black",
    size = 2.0
  ) +
  facet_grid(dose ~ ., switch = "y", labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste0(x, "~mu*'M'"), default = label_parsed)) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("blue", "blue", "lightgrey", "lightgrey", "red", "red"),
    values = c(0, v_neg_cap_all, v_neg_thresh_all, v_pos_thresh_all, v_pos_cap_all, 1),
    limits = c(-actual_max_abs, actual_max_abs),
    name = expression(beta[coef])
  ) +
  # Differentiate legend font sizes
  guides(
    color = guide_colorbar(title.theme = element_text(size = 14))
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90, size = 13), # Vertical dose labels
    strip.placement = "outside",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "cm"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 0, b = 1, l = 0, unit = "cm")
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = final_bin_order, drop = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE, clip = "off")

# 5. Create Header (Matches the interactive p_header but in ggplot)
header_data_static_all <- header_data %>%
  mutate(window = factor(as.character(window), levels = final_bin_order))

p_header_static_all <- ggplot(header_data_static_all, aes(x = window, y = 1, fill = ATAC_bin)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(header_data_static_all$bin_color, header_data_static_all$ATAC_bin)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(b = 0, unit = "cm")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE)

# 6. Combine and Save
if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(patchwork)
  combined_lollipop_all_static <- p_header_static_all / p_lollipop_all_static +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 10), guides = "collect")
} else {
  library(gridExtra)
  combined_lollipop_all_static <- grid.arrange(p_header_static_all, p_lollipop_all_static, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 10))
}

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "cells40_all_modeling_results_static_lollipop_final.pdf"),
  plot = combined_lollipop_all_static,
  width = 15, height = 10
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "cells40_all_modeling_results_static_lollipop_final.png"),
  plot = combined_lollipop_all_static,
  width = 15, height = 10, dpi = 300
)
```

# --- 11. Filtering ---
# Filter by mean_normalized_effect threshold and confidence intervals for successive bins.

```{r}
# Set threshold for the entire script
mean_norm_effect_threshold <- top_5_percent_threshold
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# The result is assigned to the new dataframe name
modeling_results_conf_int <- modeling_results %>%
  mutate(
    confidence_interval_contain_zero = if_else(
      # This condition checks if the two numbers cross zero
      conf_low_95 * conf_high_95 <= 0,

      # Value if TRUE (they have different signs or one is zero)
      "yes_contains_0",

      # Value if FALSE (they have the same sign)
      "NO"
    )
  )

# Check the first few rows of the new dataframe
head(modeling_results_conf_int)
```





# Keep only sliding windows that pass the confidence interval and effect thresholds for at least two adjacent windows
```{r}
# --- Part 1: Filtering to create 'significant_windows_only' dataframe ---
# (This section assumes your 'modeling_results_conf_int' dataframe is available)
sliding_windows_to_keep <- modeling_results_conf_int %>%
  filter(window_scheme == "sliding_window") %>%
  group_by(ATAC_bin, dose) %>%
  arrange(window_start) %>%
  filter(
    (
      (abs(mean_normalized_effect) >= mean_norm_effect_threshold & confidence_interval_contain_zero == "NO") &
        (abs(lead(mean_normalized_effect)) >= mean_norm_effect_threshold & lead(confidence_interval_contain_zero) == "NO")
    ) |
      (
        (abs(mean_normalized_effect) >= mean_norm_effect_threshold & confidence_interval_contain_zero == "NO") &
          (abs(lag(mean_normalized_effect)) >= mean_norm_effect_threshold & lag(confidence_interval_contain_zero) == "NO")
      )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(window) %>%
  unique()

small_windows_to_keep <- modeling_results_conf_int %>%
  filter(window_scheme == "small_window") %>%
  filter(abs(mean_normalized_effect) >= mean_norm_effect_threshold & confidence_interval_contain_zero == "NO") %>%
  pull(window) %>%
  unique()

control_windows_to_keep <- modeling_results_conf_int %>%
  filter(window_scheme == "NA_control_window") %>%
  filter(abs(mean_normalized_effect) >= mean_norm_effect_threshold & confidence_interval_contain_zero == "NO") %>%
  pull(window) %>%
  unique()

all_windows_to_keep <- c(
  sliding_windows_to_keep,
  small_windows_to_keep,
  control_windows_to_keep
) %>%
  unique()

significant_windows_only_w_random_controls <- modeling_results_conf_int %>%
  filter(window %in% all_windows_to_keep)

significant_windows_only <- significant_windows_only_w_random_controls %>%
  filter(ATAC_bin != "random.controls")

# --- 2. Prepare the 'significant_windows_only' Data for Plotting ---
control_bins_sig <- significant_windows_only %>%
  filter(is.na(window_start)) %>%
  arrange(window)
experimental_bins_sig <- significant_windows_only %>%
  filter(!is.na(window_start)) %>%
  arrange(window_start)
final_bin_order_sig <- c(
  unique(control_bins_sig$window),
  unique(experimental_bins_sig$window)
)
significant_windows_only$window <- factor(
  significant_windows_only$window,
  levels = final_bin_order_sig
)
significant_windows_only$dose <- factor(
  significant_windows_only$dose,
  levels = sort(unique(significant_windows_only$dose), decreasing = TRUE)
)

# --- 3. Load Manual Coloring from CSV ---
# We now use pre-assigned colors for global consistency
manual_colors_path <- "../data/ATAC_bin_color_map/manual_colors_ATAC_bins.csv"
manual_colors_df <- read.csv(manual_colors_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Create the color map using ATAC_bin and final_colors from the CSV
atac_color_map <- manual_colors_df %>%
  dplyr::select(ATAC_bin, bin_color = final_colors) %>%
  distinct()
# Force update of bin_color to use the new colors generated for the filtered set
if ("bin_color" %in% names(significant_windows_only)) {
  significant_windows_only <- significant_windows_only %>% dplyr::select(-bin_color)
}

significant_windows_only <- significant_windows_only %>%
  left_join(atac_color_map, by = "ATAC_bin")

# Export significant ATAC bins with colors for audit and comparison
atac_bin_color_map_for_audit <- significant_windows_only %>%
  dplyr::select(ATAC_bin, bin_color) %>%
  distinct()

write.csv(atac_bin_color_map_for_audit,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "significant_atac_bins_40cells_w_colors.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(significant_windows_only,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "significant_windows_only_40cells.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(modeling_results_conf_int,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "modeling_results_conf_int_40cells.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# --- 4. Define the Custom Color Scale ---
# Calculate symmetrical limits for color scale based on ACTUAL data range
actual_max_abs <- max(abs(range(significant_windows_only$mean_normalized_effect, na.rm = TRUE)))
# Ensure we cover at least the cap to avoid errors
actual_max_abs <- max(actual_max_abs, 1.5)

# Define the cap and threshold
cap_val <- 1.0
thresh_val <- mean_norm_effect_threshold

# Calculate normalized positions (0 to 1) for the gradient stops
# The scale spans from -actual_max_abs to +actual_max_abs
total_span <- 2 * actual_max_abs

# Function to normalize a value to [0, 1] given the range [-actual_max_abs, actual_max_abs]
norm_pos <- function(val) {
  (val - (-actual_max_abs)) / total_span
}

v_neg_cap <- norm_pos(-cap_val)
v_neg_thresh <- norm_pos(-thresh_val)
v_pos_thresh <- norm_pos(thresh_val)
v_pos_cap <- norm_pos(cap_val)

# Create the custom colorscale: blue -> blue -> lightgrey -> lightgrey -> red -> red
custom_colorscale <- list(
  list(0, "blue"),
  list(v_neg_cap, "blue"),
  list(v_neg_thresh, "lightgrey"),
  list(v_pos_thresh, "lightgrey"),
  list(v_pos_cap, "red"),
  list(1, "red")
)

# --- 5. Build the Header and Lollipop Plots ---
header_data <- significant_windows_only %>%
  dplyr::select(window, ATAC_bin, bin_color) %>%
  distinct()
p_header <- plot_ly(
  data = header_data, x = ~window, y = 1, type = "bar",
  marker = list(color = ~bin_color),
  hoverinfo = "text", text = ~ paste("ATAC Bin:", ATAC_bin)
) %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(showticklabels = FALSE, title = ""))

dose_plots <- list()
dose_levels <- levels(significant_windows_only$dose)

for (d in dose_levels) {
  dose_data <- filter(significant_windows_only, dose == d)
  dose_data_na <- filter(dose_data, is.na(mean_normalized_effect))
  dose_data_non_na <- filter(dose_data, !is.na(mean_normalized_effect))

  p_dose <- plot_ly(showlegend = FALSE) %>%
    add_segments(
      data = dose_data_non_na, x = ~window, y = 0,
      xend = ~window, yend = ~mean_normalized_effect,
      color = I("gray"), hoverinfo = "none"
    ) %>%
    add_markers(
      data = dose_data_non_na, x = ~window, y = ~mean_normalized_effect,
      marker = list(
        color = ~mean_normalized_effect, colorscale = custom_colorscale,
        cmin = -actual_max_abs, cmax = actual_max_abs,
        showscale = (d == "100"),
        colorbar = list(title = "Norm Effect"),
        size = 10
      ),
      hoverinfo = "text",
      # Create a detailed, multi-line tooltip
      text = ~ paste0(
        "Bin: ", ATAC_bin, "<br>",
        "Window: ", window, "<br>",
        "Scheme: ", window_scheme, "<br>",
        "Effect: ", round(mean_normalized_effect, 3), "<br>",
        "Adj. P-val: ", ifelse(is.na(adjusted_p_value), "NA", format.pval(adjusted_p_value, digits = 3)), "<br>",
        "CI: ", round(conf_low_95, 3), " - ", round(conf_high_95, 3), "<br>",
        "CI contains 0: ", confidence_interval_contain_zero, "<br>",
        "Cell Count: ", cell_count, "<br>",
        "Unique sgRNAs: ", num_unique_sgrnas, "<br>",
        "Status: ", status
      )
    ) %>%
    add_markers(
      data = dose_data_na, x = ~window, y = 0,
      marker = list(color = "black", size = 10),
      hoverinfo = "text",
      # Create a similar tooltip for NA values
      text = ~ paste0(
        "Bin: ", ATAC_bin, "<br>",
        "Window: ", window, "<br>",
        "Scheme: ", window_scheme, "<br>",
        "Effect: NA", "<br>",
        "Adj. P-val: ", ifelse(is.na(adjusted_p_value), "NA", format.pval(adjusted_p_value, digits = 3)), "<br>",
        "CI: ", round(conf_low_95, 3), " - ", round(conf_high_95, 3), "<br>",
        "CI contains 0: ", confidence_interval_contain_zero, "<br>",
        "Cell Count: ", cell_count, "<br>",
        "Unique sgRNAs: ", num_unique_sgrnas, "<br>",
        "Status: ", status
      )
    ) %>%
    add_annotations(
      text = paste(d), x = 1, y = 0.5,
      xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
      xanchor = "left", showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(size = 14)
    )

  dose_plots[[as.character(d)]] <- p_dose
}

# --- 6. Combine All Plots and Enforce Order ---
final_plot_significant <- subplot(
  p_header, dose_plots[["100"]], dose_plots[["50"]],
  dose_plots[["10"]], dose_plots[["0"]],
  nrows = 5, heights = c(0.1, 0.225, 0.225, 0.225, 0.225),
  shareX = TRUE, titleY = TRUE
) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Genomic Window",
      categoryorder = "array",
      categoryarray = final_bin_order_sig, # Use the new order for significant windows
      tickangle = 60
    ),
    title = list(text = "Dose-Dependent Effect for Significant Windows Only_detailed hover_FINAL", y = 0.99)
  )

# --- 7. Save the Final Interactive Plot ---
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  widget = final_plot_significant,
  file = file.path(output_dir, "cells40_interactive_lollipop_nominal_hit_windows_detailed_hover_FINAL.html")
)
```

```{r}
library(tidyr)

all_sgRNA_across_significant_windows <- significant_windows_only %>%
```

```{r}
# --- Static Heatmap ---
library(ggplot2)
# Try to load patchwork, if not available, we might need another method,
# but assuming it's available or we can use gridExtra.
# For robustness, I'll check if patchwork is installed, otherwise use grid.
if (!requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (!requireNamespace("gridExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Please install 'patchwork' or 'gridExtra' to generate the static heatmap.")
  }
  library(gridExtra)
  use_patchwork <- FALSE
} else {
  library(patchwork)
  use_patchwork <- TRUE
}

# 1. Prepare Data
# Reuse significant_windows_only from previous chunks
static_data <- significant_windows_only

# Ensure factors are set
static_data$window <- factor(static_data$window, levels = final_bin_order_sig)
static_data$dose <- factor(static_data$dose, levels = sort(unique(static_data$dose), decreasing = FALSE))

# 2. Header Plot
# We need a dataframe with one row per window for the header
header_data_static <- static_data %>%
  dplyr::select(window, ATAC_bin, bin_color) %>%
  distinct()

p_header_static <- ggplot(header_data_static, aes(x = window, y = 1, fill = ATAC_bin)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(atac_color_map$bin_color, atac_color_map$ATAC_bin)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(b = 0, unit = "cm"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# --- Static Lollipop Plot (Replicating Interactive Style) ---

# 1. Prepare Data (Reuse static_data)
# Ensure dose is a factor with correct order (reversed for top-to-bottom: 100, 50, 10, 0)
# Use as.character to ensure we match the levels correctly regardless of input type
static_data_lolli <- static_data %>%
  mutate(dose = factor(as.character(dose), levels = c("100", "50", "10", "0")))

# 2. Define Color Scale (Reuse logic)
# We need to re-calculate these if they aren't in scope, or just use them.
# To be safe, let's re-define the scale parameters based on the data.

actual_max_abs_lolli <- max(abs(range(static_data$mean_normalized_effect, na.rm = TRUE)))
actual_max_abs_lolli <- max(actual_max_abs_lolli, 1.5)
cap_val_lolli <- 1.0
thresh_val_lolli <- mean_norm_effect_threshold
total_span_lolli <- 2 * actual_max_abs_lolli

norm_pos_lolli <- function(val) {
  (val - (-actual_max_abs_lolli)) / total_span_lolli
}

v_neg_cap_lolli <- norm_pos_lolli(-cap_val_lolli)
v_neg_thresh_lolli <- norm_pos_lolli(-thresh_val_lolli)
v_pos_thresh_lolli <- norm_pos_lolli(thresh_val_lolli)
v_pos_cap_lolli <- norm_pos_lolli(cap_val_lolli)

# 3. Create Lollipop Plot
# 3. Create Lollipop Plot
p_lollipop_static <- ggplot(static_data_lolli, aes(x = window)) +
  # Stems (grey)
  geom_segment(
    data = subset(static_data_lolli, !is.na(mean_normalized_effect)),
    aes(xend = window, y = 0, yend = mean_normalized_effect),
    color = "gray"
  ) +
  # Points (colored by effect)
  geom_point(
    data = subset(static_data_lolli, !is.na(mean_normalized_effect)),
    aes(y = mean_normalized_effect, color = mean_normalized_effect),
    size = 2.0
  ) +
  # NA values (points at 0, #CCCCCC)
  geom_point(
    data = subset(static_data_lolli, is.na(mean_normalized_effect)),
    aes(y = 0),
    color = "black",
    size = 2.0
  ) +
  # Facet by Dose (stacked vertically) with microMolar unit mathematically parsed
  facet_grid(dose ~ ., switch = "y", labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste0(x, "~mu*'M'"), default = label_parsed)) +
  # Custom Color Scale
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("blue", "blue", "lightgrey", "lightgrey", "red", "red"),
    values = c(0, v_neg_cap_lolli, v_neg_thresh_lolli, v_pos_thresh_lolli, v_pos_cap_lolli, 1),
    limits = c(-actual_max_abs_lolli, actual_max_abs_lolli),
    name = expression(beta[coef])
  ) +
  # Differentiate legend font sizes
  guides(
    color = guide_colorbar(title.theme = element_text(size = 14))
  ) +
  # Theme and Layout
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), # Hide x-axis labels (shared with header)
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90, size = 13), # Vertical dose labels
    strip.placement = "outside",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "cm"), # Increase spacing between facets
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 1, l = 1, unit = "cm") # Add margin for clipped points
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE, clip = "off") # Allow points to extend beyond panel

# 4. Combine with Header (p_header_static from heatmap chunk)
if (use_patchwork) {
  combined_lollipop_static <- p_header_static / p_lollipop_static +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 10), guides = "collect")
} else {
  combined_lollipop_static <- grid.arrange(p_header_static, p_lollipop_static, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 10))
}

# 5. Save
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "cells40_static_lollipop_significant_windows.pdf"),
  plot = combined_lollipop_static,
  width = 12, height = 8 # Slightly taller for lollipops
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "cells40_static_lollipop_significant_windows.png"),
  plot = combined_lollipop_static,
  width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
# --- Static Lollipop Plot Scaled to Cell Number ---

# 1. Prepare Data (Reuse static_data)
# Ensure dose is a factor with correct order (reversed for top-to-bottom: 100, 50, 10, 0)
# Use as.character to ensure we match the levels correctly regardless of input type
static_data_lolli <- static_data %>%
  mutate(dose = factor(as.character(dose), levels = c("100", "50", "10", "0")))

# --- Step 1: Calculate Dynamic Limits ---
sig_cell_range <- range(significant_windows_only$cell_count, na.rm = TRUE)
min_sig_cells <- sig_cell_range[1]
max_sig_cells <- sig_cell_range[2]

# 2. Define Color Scale (Reuse logic)
# We need to re-calculate these if they aren't in scope, or just use them.
# To be safe, let's re-define the scale parameters based on the data.

actual_max_abs_lolli <- max(abs(range(static_data$mean_normalized_effect, na.rm = TRUE)))
actual_max_abs_lolli <- max(actual_max_abs_lolli, 1.5)
cap_val_lolli <- 1.0
thresh_val_lolli <- mean_norm_effect_threshold
total_span_lolli <- 2 * actual_max_abs_lolli

norm_pos_lolli <- function(val) {
  (val - (-actual_max_abs_lolli)) / total_span_lolli
}

v_neg_cap_lolli <- norm_pos_lolli(-cap_val_lolli)
v_neg_thresh_lolli <- norm_pos_lolli(-thresh_val_lolli)
v_pos_thresh_lolli <- norm_pos_lolli(thresh_val_lolli)
v_pos_cap_lolli <- norm_pos_lolli(cap_val_lolli)

# 3. Create Lollipop Plot
p_lollipop_static <- ggplot(static_data_lolli, aes(x = window)) +
  # Stems (grey)
  geom_segment(
    data = subset(static_data_lolli, !is.na(mean_normalized_effect)),
    aes(xend = window, y = 0, yend = mean_normalized_effect),
    color = "gray"
  ) +
  # Points (colored by effect, sized by cell count) [Step 2]
  geom_point(
    data = subset(static_data_lolli, !is.na(mean_normalized_effect)),
    aes(y = mean_normalized_effect, color = mean_normalized_effect, size = cell_count),
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  # NA values (points at 0, #CCCCCC)
  geom_point(
    data = subset(static_data_lolli, is.na(mean_normalized_effect)),
    aes(y = 0, size = cell_count),
    color = "black"
  ) +
  # Facet by Dose (stacked vertically) with microMolar unit mathematically parsed
  facet_grid(dose ~ ., switch = "y", labeller = as_labeller(function(x) paste0(x, "~mu*'M'"), default = label_parsed)) +
  # Custom Color Scale
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colors = c("blue", "blue", "lightgrey", "lightgrey", "red", "red"),
    values = c(0, v_neg_cap_lolli, v_neg_thresh_lolli, v_pos_thresh_lolli, v_pos_cap_lolli, 1),
    limits = c(-actual_max_abs_lolli, actual_max_abs_lolli),
    name = expression(beta[coef])
  ) +
  # --- Step 3: Define the Size Scale ---
  scale_size_continuous(
    limits = c(min_sig_cells, max_sig_cells),
    range  = c(1, 6), # Adjust 6 if the dots for MSH2 look too "crowded"
    name   = "Cell\ncount",
    breaks = c(min_sig_cells, 500, 1000, max_sig_cells)
  ) +
  # Differentiate legend font sizes
  guides(
    color = guide_colorbar(title.theme = element_text(size = 14)),
    size = guide_legend(title.theme = element_text(size = 12))
  ) +
  # Theme and Layout
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9), # Explicitly size the effect size tick markers
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), # Hide x-axis labels (shared with header)
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90, size = 13), # Vertical dose labels
    strip.placement = "outside",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "cm"), # Increase spacing between facets
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 1, b = 1, l = 1, unit = "cm") # Add margin for clipped points
  ) +
  labs(y = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE, clip = "off") # Allow points to extend beyond panel

# 4. Combine with Header (p_header_static from heatmap chunk)
if (use_patchwork) {
  combined_lollipop_static <- p_header_static / p_lollipop_static +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 10), guides = "collect")
} else {
  combined_lollipop_static <- grid.arrange(p_header_static, p_lollipop_static, ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 10))
}

# 5. Save
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "40cell_threshold_cell_number_static_lollipop_significant_windows.pdf"),
  plot = combined_lollipop_static,
  width = 12, height = 8 # Slightly taller for lollipops
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(output_dir, "40cell_threshold_cell_number_static_lollipop_significant_windows.png"),
  plot = combined_lollipop_static,
  width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300
)
```
